title: Mureka V9
description: Mureka V9 — songs that sing your exact lyrics (structural tags like [verse]/[chorus] supported) with a vocal gender preference, or instrumental/BGM tracks from a prompt. MP3 output.

instrumental.description: Generate an instrumental/BGM track from the prompt (no vocals, lyrics ignored).

lyrics.description: Lyrics to sing verbatim (1-5000 characters; [verse]/[chorus]/[bridge] tags supported). Required for songs; ignored for instrumental tracks.

prompt.description: Style hint (up to 1024 characters). Optional for songs; required for instrumental tracks.
